title: Use a bow drill
kid_text: A grown-up pulls the bow back and forth.
safety: The coal is hot. Do not hold it in your hand.

steps.text: Pick dry soft wood for both pieces.
The spindle is a straight dry stick.
The hearth is a flat dry board.
The bearing block is a hard palm-size piece.
Cut a small pit in the hearth.
Cut a notch from that pit to the edge.
Press down and pull the bow in long strokes.
Stop when thick smoke pours out.
Catch the coal on a chip of bark.
Move that coal into the nest.

mistakes.text: The string is so tight it will not move.
mistakes.fix: Loosen it until the spindle turns.

mistakes.text: The wood is green and shiny.
mistakes.fix: Use dead wood that you can dent.
